propositions: The harness must build locally from a vendored Dockerfile pinning the addono base image by digest (not pull a non-existent registry image), because pycontribs/jira-test-image is a local build name never published to Docker Hub.

The vendored Dockerfile must retain -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout on the atlas-run entrypoint, because the Marketplace v1 endpoint is retired and Cargo's 600-second deploy ceiling kills cold starts on slow runners without the timeout override.

A readiness probe must poll the Jira REST endpoint until it responds, with a generous timeout (default 20 minutes, env-overridable) and a 5-second cadence, because Maven download and emulated amd64 execution on arm64 hosts can exceed the upstream's quoted 3-5 minute startup.

The smoke tests must exercise Personal Access Token bearer authentication (minted via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens) and REST v2 round-trip create/read semantics, proving the DC transport's auth mode and protocol version are real, not assumed.

Teardown must verify deletion by polling each issue's direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint until 404 is returned (never consulting search), per ADR 0037 §3, because Jira's search index lags by an unbounded interval and cannot be relied upon.

The acceptance evidence must be produced on a native amd64 runner (GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest), not emulated arm64, because the harness demonstrably does not become usable within practical time bounds under emulation.
